"""Refunds, credits and manual adjustments made by the support team (moved over from the old billing monolith)."""

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .invoice import invoice_total
from .money import ZERO, round_money, to_money

# Finance policy FIN-2026-09: support-initiated refunds/credits above this
# amount require approval.
APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = to_money("1000.00")


def manual_adjustment(invoice, amount, note):
    if invoice.status not in ("issued", "paid"):
        raise ValueError("can only adjust issued or paid invoices")
    if not note:
        raise ValueError("a note is required")
    return {"invoice_id": invoice.id, "amount": amount, "note": note}


def adjustable_balance(invoice) -> float:
    return float(invoice_total(invoice))


def outage_refund(payment, amount, at):
    """Refund part of a captured payment after a service outage.

    ``amount`` is added to ``payment.refunded_amount``; once the full captured
    amount has been refunded the payment status becomes ``"refunded"``.
    """
    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")

    captured = round_money(payment.amount)
    already_refunded = round_money(payment.refunded_amount)
    if already_refunded + amount > captured:
        raise BillingError(
            "refund_exceeds_captured",
            f"{already_refunded + amount} > {captured}",
        )
    if amount > APPROVAL_THRESHOLD:
        raise BillingError(
            "approval_required",
            f"refund {amount} exceeds threshold {APPROVAL_THRESHOLD}",
        )

    at = ensure_utc(at)
    payment.refunded_amount = already_refunded + amount
    if payment.refunded_amount >= captured:
        payment.status = "refunded"

    audit.record(
        "outage_refund",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        refunded_amount=payment.refunded_amount,
        at=at,
    )
    return payment

from .invoice import invoice_total
from .money import ZERO, round_money, to_money

# Finance policy FIN-2026-09: support-initiated refunds/credits above this
# amount require a second approver. Raised from 500.00 to 1000.00 in 2.0.0.
APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = to_money("1000.00")


def manual_adjustment(invoice, amount, note):
    if invoice.status not in ("issued", "paid"):
        raise ValueError("can only adjust issued or paid invoices")
    if not note:
        raise ValueError("a note is required")
    return {"invoice_id": invoice.id, "amount": amount, "note": note}


def adjustable_balance(invoice) -> float:
    return float(invoice_total(invoice))


def outage_refund(payment, amount, at, *, approved_by=None):
    """Refund part of a captured payment after a service outage.

    ``amount`` is added to ``payment.refunded_amount``; once the full captured
    amount has been refunded the payment status becomes ``"refunded"``.

    Refunds above :data:`APPROVAL_THRESHOLD` require a second approver, passed
    as ``approved_by``; otherwise ``BillingError("approval_required")`` is
    raised. Amounts at or below the threshold need no approval.
    """
    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")

    captured = round_money(payment.amount)
    already_refunded = round_money(payment.refunded_amount)
    if already_refunded + amount > captured:
        raise BillingError(
            "refund_exceeds_captured",
            f"{already_refunded + amount} > {captured}",
        )
    if amount > APPROVAL_THRESHOLD and not approved_by:
        raise BillingError(
            "approval_required",
            f"refund {amount} exceeds threshold {APPROVAL_THRESHOLD}",
        )

    at = ensure_utc(at)
    payment.refunded_amount = already_refunded + amount
    if payment.refunded_amount >= captured:
        payment.status = "refunded"

    audit.record(
        "outage_refund",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        refunded_amount=payment.refunded_amount,
        approved_by=approved_by,
        at=at,
    )
    return payment
EOF
